title: Back-Translation Still Matters: Leveraging Monolingual Data for Low-Resource Machine Translation with LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.18818v2 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Pre-trained Large Language Model (LLMs) are effective on many tasks in zero-shot and few-shot settings. For machine translation of low-resource languages, the obvious options are few-shot prompting and fine-tuning on a small parallel set. We ask: what if moderate amounts of low-resource monolingual data are also available? We argue that, rather than continued pretraining, a more effective use of this data is the pre-LLM era technique of back-translation (BT). The current fine-tuned LLM translates monolingual sentences in each language, and the resulting pairs train it in the reverse direction. Updates on the parallel set are interleaved for stable learning. With 1K parallel pairs on Odia and Swahili, BT beats continued pretraining into the low-resource language by 7.7 to 16.4 XCOMET-XXL points in domain. translated_title: 回译依然重要：利用单语数据实现基于大语言模型的低资源机器翻译
translated_abstract: 预训练大语言模型（LLM）在零样本和少样本设置下对许多任务都很有效。对于低资源语言的机器翻译，显而易见的选择是少样本提示和在小型平行语料上进行微调。我们提出一个问题：如果同时还有适量规模的低资源单语数据可用，情况会怎样？我们认为，比起继续预训练，更有效地利用这些数据的方法是大语言模型时代之前的技术——回译（BT）。具体做法是：让当前微调后的大语言模型对每种语言的单语句子进行翻译，将得到的句对用于反向方向的训练，并与平行语料上的更新交错进行以保证学习的稳定性。在Odia语和斯瓦希里语上仅使用1K平行句对的情况下，回译在域内测试中比向低资源语言继续预训练高出7.7到16.4个XCOMET-XXL分数。使用束搜索解码的中间翻译结果时，它还击败了拥有10倍平行数据量的模型。
tldr: 对于低资源机器翻译，利用单语数据做回译比继续预训练大语言模型更有效，仅需1K平行句对即可超越继续预训练7.7至16.4个XCOMET-XXL分，甚至优于拥有10倍平行数据的模型。
en_tdlr: For low-resource machine translation, back-translation is a more effective way to leverage monolingual data than continued LLM pretraining, beating it by 7.7-16.4 XCOMET-XXL points with only 1K parallel pairs and even outperforming models trained with 10x more parallel data.
